title: Does the -50% premium catastrophe cap cut opposite ways by STRIKE TIER (ATM arms vs OTM arms) on live fills, and should the ATM pool get a looser width at 10-30?
frozen_by: Fable, interactive new-week session 2026-09-08 (J: what are we doing to improve)
classification: EXPANSION for the ATM pool (a looser cap admits more downside) -> 2026-10-30 only, never 2026-09-29. The OTM pool's cap is NOT loosened by this prereg under any outcome.
disclosure_first_look: The author split analysis/recommendations/catastrophe-cap-shadow-ledger.jsonl by arm ONCE before freezing (n=40 cap fires, 2026-07-23..2026-09-08): bold-2 n=16 held_to_eod delta -1260 (cap SAVES); safe-2 n=9 +1407, safe-3 n=7 +1246, risky-1 n=5 +1375, risky-3 n=3 +563 (cap COSTS vs hold-to-EOD). This look is why the prereg exists; the rule below is frozen before any further accrual and the 10-30 read uses ONLY fires dated after this file's first commit for the decision, with the pre-freeze split reported alongside as context.
parent_study: analysis/recommendations/prereg-catastrophe-cap-decision-2026-08-09.json (adjudicated NULL on the pooled book: no width cleared all 4 gates). This prereg asks the per-tier question that study pooled away (C29: exit knobs ratified on one strike tier do not transfer).

populations.ATM_pool: arms whose live strike table resolves to offset 0 at their equity: safe-2 (V15_SAFE_TIERS), safe-3, risky-1 (fleet tables) -- re-resolve from crypto/lib/strike_selection.py at read time, never hardcode
populations.OTM_pool: arms resolving to a negative offset: bold-2 (heartbeat_core.py:2679 uses V15_BOLD_TIERS -> OTM-2 at $2K-10K, confirmed by the 2026-09-08 766P fill with SPY 767.65), risky-3
populations.ledger: analysis/recommendations/catastrophe-cap-shadow-ledger.jsonl rows: actual_realized_pnl vs held_to_eod_counterfactual_pnl per cap fire
populations.forward_window: rows with date_et > this file's first commit date, through 2026-10-29

decision_rule.candidate_width_for_ATM_pool: CAP_70 (-70%), the parent study's only width that cleared G_TAIL
decision_rule.ACT: ATM pool has n>=15 forward cap fires AND CAP_70 clears all 4 gates on the ATM pool alone -> file a forward PAPER trial of -70% on the ATM pool for the 10-30 checkpoint packet (expansion); revert = git revert of the params exit-key change
decision_rule.NULL: anything else. Explicitly: G_AGGREGATE alone never ships (it passed in the parent and was rightly refused).
decision_rule.OTM_pool_outcome: reported only. If the OTM pool shows a TIGHTER width clearing all 4 gates, that is a separate 09-29-class reduction prereg, not this file.

kill_list: ATM pool n<15 forward fires at 10-30 -> NULL, extend to 11-30
top-3 fires > 50% of the pool's delta -> NULL (concentration)
held_to_eod counterfactual is the extreme alternative; if the ledger gains a CAP_70 counterfactual column, use it instead and say so
what_this_is_NOT: Not a change to anything live. Not evidence that Bold's OTM-2 tier is wrong (that is a strike-tier question with its own history: atm-tier-extension-2k10k-prereg-2026-08-03, STRIKE-MATRIX-2026-08-18 'close to a wash').
reversible_action: On ACT at 10-30: per-arm params exit key premium_stop_pct -0.5 -> -0.7 for the ATM pool only, applied with GAMMA_FREEZE_OVERRIDE per checkpoint procedure; revert = git revert.
output: Verdict block written into this file's evidence by the 10-30 read (checkpoint_packet.py auto-discovers by status string).
